sources.entry: Specht - Rule-based proxy app built with Network Extension for macOS.

summary.one_liner: Specht is a rule-based proxy app for macOS built on Network Extension, now archived because its NEKit dependency is deprecated.
summary.what_it_does: The README is nearly empty: it only has the project name and a single line saying Specht is archived because NEKit is deprecated. It does not describe features, configuration, or usage. The listing metadata describes it as a rule-based proxy app built with Network Extension for macOS. No further capabilities are documented in the README.
use_cases: studying a network extension proxy app
notable: Built on Apple's Network Extension framework for macOS
Rule-based proxy design, per the listing description
Depends on NEKit, which the README says is deprecated
caveats: Archived; the README gives no active maintenance
README provides no setup or usage instructions
